title: Verdacht des erpresserischen Menschenraubes im Supermarkt - Untersuchungshaft

extraction.summaryEn: A 29-year-old man allegedly held a supermarket employee hostage at knifepoint, using pepper spray and restraints, and made demands. Police freed the woman the next morning and overpowered the suspect with a stun device; he was remanded in custody.
